title: God Inside
character: the same young Black woman from the reference photos: sleek jet-black chin-length bob with a deep side part and soft flipped ends, warm deep-brown skin, glamorous makeup with glossy nude-pink lips, long silver crystal drop earrings, a fitted red mermaid gown with short sheer cap sleeves covered in red and silver beaded embroidery and sequins
venue: an intimate dark nightclub: small low stage, exposed brick walls, round cocktail tables with candles close to the stage, warm haze in the air, soft bulb string lights glowing in the background, one hard-edged warm spotlight as the key light
crowd: 20 to 40 patrons in warm neutral clothing (cream, camel, tan, chocolate brown), mixed ages, mostly Black and brown adults, engaged and supportive
ltx_negative: still image with no motion, subtitles, text, scene change

scenes.still: Cinematic wide shot of a dark, intimate nightclub, small low stage with an empty vintage chrome microphone on a stand, a single hard-edged spotlight beam cutting through thick haze onto the empty stage, silhouettes of seated patrons at round candlelit tables in the foreground, warm bokeh string lights on exposed brick walls, moody low-key lighting, 35mm film grain.
scenes.motion: Slow crane drift forward through the haze toward the empty microphone stand. The spotlight beam sweeps slowly across the stage. Silhouetted patrons murmur and shift in their seats. No people on stage.

scenes.still: The woman from image 1, wearing the red beaded mermaid gown from image 2, steps out of darkness into a single warm spotlight on the small nightclub stage from image 3, head bowed, silver drop earrings catching the light, hand reaching for the handheld microphone. Low-angle cinematic view, haze, candlelit patrons blurred in the foreground.
scenes.motion: The woman in the red beaded gown steps forward into the spotlight, slowly lifts her head and raises the microphone to her lips. Low-angle push-in. The crowd hushes, haze drifts through the beam.

scenes.still: Close-up of the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2, eyes gently closed, singing softly into a handheld microphone under a tight warm spotlight, soft haze, shallow depth of field, dark blurred nightclub background from image 3, amber highlights and deep shadows.
scenes.motion: Static close-up. The woman sings softly into the microphone with her eyes closed, lips moving with the lyrics, subtle breathing and head movement. Haze drifts behind her.

scenes.still: Medium shot of the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 under a single spotlight on the small stage from image 3, eyes open, one hand resting over her heart while she sings into the microphone, blurred silhouettes of patrons at candlelit tables in the dark foreground.
scenes.motion: The woman sings with one hand over her heart, gently swaying to the music. Slow handheld camera drift circling slightly. Patrons sway softly in the foreground.

scenes.still: Wide over-the-shoulder shot from behind seated patrons looking toward the small nightclub stage from image 3, where the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 sings under a lone spotlight. Heads and shoulders of an attentive, smiling crowd in warm neutral clothes fill the foreground, haze catches the beam, exposed brick, string lights.
scenes.motion: Wide shot from behind the crowd. The woman on stage sings into the microphone under the spotlight. Patrons in the foreground smile and nod along. Very slow push forward.

scenes.still: Close shot of the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 gripping the handheld microphone tightly near her lips, face lit by a warming spotlight, expression intensifying mid-lyric, dark hazy nightclub background from image 3, warm rim light, shallow focus.
scenes.motion: Slow push-in on the woman's hand gripping the microphone, rising to her face as she sings with building intensity. The spotlight warms slightly.

scenes.still: Side view of the woman from image 1 in the red beaded mermaid gown from image 2 walking slowly across the small nightclub stage from image 3, singing passionately into the microphone, a spotlight following her, haze trails in the beam, crowd silhouettes turning to watch.
scenes.motion: Tracking side dolly. The woman walks slowly across the stage while singing passionately, the spotlight sweeping to follow her. Crowd heads turn to follow her.

scenes.still: Low-angle shot from inside the crowd looking up at the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 at the edge of the small stage from image 3, leaning forward, free hand reaching toward the audience while singing into the microphone, spotlight haloing around her, raised hands of patrons reaching into frame.
scenes.motion: Low angle from the crowd. The woman leans toward the audience, reaching out with her free hand while singing. Patrons' hands reach up toward her. Energy rising.

scenes.still: Medium shot of the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 on the small stage from image 3, head tilted back slightly, one arm raised triumphantly, belting into the microphone, spotlight blooming wide and bright with lens flare through haze.
scenes.motion: Slow-motion medium shot. The woman belts the chorus with her head tilted back and one arm raised high. The spotlight blooms wider and brighter, lens flare through the haze.

scenes.still: Wide shot of the entire small nightclub from image 3: the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 singing center stage in a wide bright spotlight, a standing crowd in warm neutral clothes with hands raised and phone flashlights glowing, singing along, warm haze.
scenes.motion: Crane pull-back revealing the whole room. The woman sings center stage while the standing crowd raises their hands and waves phone lights, singing along.

scenes.still: Close-up of the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 singing with intense emotion under a bright spotlight, light glistening on her skin, eyes wide with passion, blurred joyful crowd at the edges of the frame, dark nightclub from image 3.
scenes.motion: Close-up. The woman sings with intense emotion, eyes wide, glistening skin. Blurred crowd moves and sings at the edges of the frame.

scenes.still: The woman from image 1 in the red beaded mermaid gown from image 2 turning gracefully on the small stage from image 3, arms open wide to an adoring crowd, gown sparkling in the spotlight, haze swirling.
scenes.motion: Circular dolly around the woman as she turns gently with her arms open wide, still singing, her beaded gown sparkling in the spotlight. Haze swirls.

scenes.still: Medium front shot of the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 walking slowly toward the front of the small stage from image 3, softer warm spotlight, singing with quiet intensity while looking out at patrons at candlelit tables.
scenes.motion: Slow push-in from the front. The woman walks slowly downstage, singing with quiet intensity and looking out at the crowd. Softer warm light.

scenes.still: Shot from behind and beside the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 crouching at the edge of the small stage from image 3, gently touching the outstretched hand of a smiling woman patron in a cream blouse, singing with a warm smile, soft spotlight spill.
scenes.motion: The woman crouches at the stage edge and gently holds a patron's outstretched hand while singing with a warm smile. Tender moment, slow camera drift.

scenes.still: The woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 standing and turning back toward center stage of the small nightclub from image 3, spotlight narrowing into a tighter focused beam around her, contemplative expression, warm rim light, haze.
scenes.motion: Slow reverse dolly. The woman rises and turns back toward center stage, singing, as the spotlight narrows into a tight beam around her.

scenes.still: The woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 pacing across the small stage from image 3 with expressive hand gestures while singing, spotlight pulsing, crowd in warm neutral clothes beginning to rise from their seats in the background.
scenes.motion: Handheld tracking shot. The woman paces the stage singing with bigger gestures. The spotlight pulses with the music; patrons begin to stand up.

scenes.still: Low wide shot from crowd level of the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 standing center stage in the nightclub from image 3, both hands raised holding the microphone high, the entire standing crowd silhouetted in the foreground, bright anticipatory spotlight.
scenes.motion: Low wide shot. The woman stands center stage raising the microphone high with both hands, drawing a deep breath, then brings it to her lips to sing. Standing crowd silhouetted in front.

scenes.still: Low-angle hero shot of the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 belting powerfully into the microphone under a blazing bright spotlight, haze swirling around her, crowd erupting with raised arms in soft focus behind her, nightclub from image 3.
scenes.motion: Slow-motion low-angle hero shot. The woman belts with full power, haze swirling dramatically around her. The crowd cheers with raised arms.

scenes.still: The woman from image 1 in the red beaded mermaid gown from image 2 singing passionately on the small stage from image 3, hair and gown in motion, bright spotlight flaring through haze, blurred energetic crowd around the stage.
scenes.motion: Circular dolly orbiting the woman as she sings passionately, her bob hair swinging and gown sparkling, spotlight flaring through the haze.

scenes.still: Wide symmetrical shot of the full, lively nightclub from image 3: the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 on the central stage under a bright spotlight, gesturing out toward patrons in warm neutral clothes singing along arm in arm, warm haze, string lights.
scenes.motion: Wide symmetrical shot, slow push-in. The woman sings and gestures to the crowd; patrons sing along arm in arm, swaying together.

scenes.still: Close-up of the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 with a joyful tearful smile, eyes glistening, holding the microphone near her lips under a warm steady spotlight, soft haze, dark blurred nightclub from image 3.
scenes.motion: Slow push-in close-up. The woman finishes the chorus line with a joyful, tearful smile, eyes glistening, then sings again softly.

scenes.still: Close-up of the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 standing alone in a single tight spotlight on an otherwise dark stage from image 3, eyes closed, vulnerable raw expression, singing into the microphone, deep shadows, faint haze.
scenes.motion: Static intimate close-up. The woman sings quietly with eyes closed, vulnerable and raw, in a single tight spotlight. Everything else is dark.

scenes.still: Faces of a hushed, moved nightclub crowd in warm neutral clothing, some patrons with hands over their hearts and eyes closed, candlelight on their faces, and in the distance the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 singing alone under a single spotlight on the small stage from image 3.
scenes.motion: Slow pan across the hushed crowd, hands over hearts, eyes closed, deeply moved, ending on the woman singing alone in the distant spotlight.

scenes.still: Low-angle shot of the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 on the small stage from image 3, slowly raising her free hand upward as she sings, spotlight beginning to warm and widen around her, silhouetted crowd rising in the background.
scenes.motion: Low-angle push-in. The woman slowly raises her free hand upward while singing. The spotlight warms and widens; the crowd rises behind her.

scenes.still: High wide view over the nightclub from image 3 in full celebration: the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 under the brightest golden spotlight yet, haze glowing gold, the whole crowd on their feet with arms raised and phone lights glowing, singing along.
scenes.motion: Sweeping crane rise from stage level to a high wide angle. The woman sings in golden light while the whole crowd dances with arms raised and phone lights waving.

scenes.still: The woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 holding a powerful final high note, mouth open in full-voice belt, microphone raised, golden light particles and haze drifting, ecstatic roaring crowd with raised arms behind her, nightclub from image 3.
scenes.motion: Arcing crane move from close to wide. The woman holds a long powerful final note, then the ecstatic crowd roars with raised arms. Golden particles drift.

scenes.still: Medium shot of the woman from image 1 in the red beaded gown from image 2 lowering the microphone slightly after her final note, eyes closed, a small content smile, spotlight dimming around her, warm afterglow haze, still reverent crowd silhouettes, dark nightclub from image 3.
scenes.motion: Static medium shot. The woman lowers the microphone, eyes closed, small content smile. The spotlight slowly fades to black.
